An R package for exploring classification decision boundaries.

## Installation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
devtools::install_github("natydasilva/classbound")
```

## Quick Start

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(classbound)
data(data69_1)
# Explore classification boundaries
```
